sources.title: OpenRLHF: An Easy-to-use, Scalableand High-performance RLHF Framework
sources.snippet: The foundational RLHF framework trains a reward model using human preference data and optimizes the language model with reinforcement learning algorithms, such as PPO [15]. This approach has been successfully deployed in prominent models, including InstructGPT [16], ChatGPT, and GPT-4 [5].
